title: Copyright Protection & Data Plagiarism
description: My work addresses two related problems: protecting personal data against unauthorized use in model training, and exposing how generative models reproduce copyrighted content. Anti-Neuron Watermarking studies ownership verification, while Neural Plagiarism examines forgery and copyright ambiguity in diffusion models.

title: Law & Physics Compliance
description: I study how neural networks can follow legal requirements and physical rules in the scenarios where they operate. This includes deriving driving requirements from traffic laws and using the traffic-flow fundamental diagram to constrain adversarial examples. My current work also builds physically grounded simulation environments, combining vehicle dynamics and interactions between vehicles for reinforcement learning.

title: Efficient & Lifelong Learning
description: I am interested in models that learn with less data and computation and continue adapting as tasks and environments change. The goal is to acquire new capabilities efficiently while retaining useful knowledge from earlier experience.
